concepts.breathing: Current breathing explicitly reported by the patient or proxy.
concepts.breathing_without_help: Explicitly breathing without assistance now; not inferred from typing.
concepts.responds_to_voice: Explicit current response to voice; not inferred from typing.
concepts.responding_normally: Explicit report of responding as usual; not an examination finding.
concepts.chest_discomfort: Reported chest pain, pressure or discomfort.
concepts.chest_pressure: Reported pressure sensation in the chest.
concepts.pain_radiates_left_arm: Reported pain spreading to the left arm.
concepts.sweating: Reported sweating associated with the complaint.
concepts.onset_today: Explicit onset today; do not calculate dates.
concepts.sudden_onset: Explicit abrupt onset, not merely recent onset.
concepts.worst_ever_headache: Explicitly reported worst headache the person has experienced.
concepts.previous_headaches: Reported history of headaches; absent only when explicitly denied.
concepts.peanut_exposure: Reported peanut exposure associated with this complaint.
concepts.peanut_allergy: Known peanut allergy explicitly reported as history.
concepts.fever: Subjective reported fever or feeling feverish, never measured temperature.
concepts.current_chemotherapy: Explicit report of currently receiving chemotherapy.
concepts.cancer_history: Cancer explicitly reported as known history; never inferred from symptoms.
concepts.used_needle_puncture: Reported puncture by a needle just used on another person.
concepts.onset_just_now: Explicitly just happened, without inventing a time threshold.
concepts.excess_medication_ingestion: Explicit report of taking more than prescribed; no dose calculation.
concepts.new_confusion: Reported confusion explicitly described as new.
concepts.change_from_mental_baseline: Explicit reported change from the usual mental baseline.
concepts.current_suicidal_intent: Explicit current suicidal intent, not a past event or hypothetical mention.
concepts.severe_pain: Explicitly described severe pain; a numeric score alone does not establish this concept.
concepts.cancer_related_pain: Patient explicitly attributes current pain to known cancer; not model attribution.
concepts.unable_to_get_comfortable: Explicit report of being unable to get comfortable.
concepts.right_lower_abdominal_pain: Reported pain specifically in the lower right abdomen; unspecified stomach pain is insufficient.
concepts.known_medical_conditions: Known medical conditions explicitly reported or denied. Unreported is unknown.
concepts.moderate_pain: Explicitly described moderate pain; no numerical-score conversion.
concepts.one_sided_lower_leg_pain: Reported pain in one lower leg.
concepts.one_sided_lower_leg_swelling: Reported swelling in one lower leg, not observed edema.
concepts.prolonged_car_travel: A reported long car journey associated with the complaint; no invented duration cutoff.
concepts.ankle_twist: Reported twisting injury to the ankle.
concepts.ankle_swelling: Reported ankle swelling, not an examination finding.
concepts.pain_on_weight_bearing: Reported pain when putting weight on the affected limb.
concepts.mild_pain_or_discomfort: Explicitly described mild pain or discomfort; no numerical-score conversion.
concepts.female_reported_sex: Explicitly reported female sex; do not infer from names, pronouns or symptoms.
concepts.burning_urination: Reported burning or stinging when urinating.
concepts.pregnancy: Pregnancy explicitly reported or denied; never inferred from age or sex.
concepts.separated_wound_edges: Reported separated wound edges; not an assessed need for sutures.
concepts.ongoing_wound_bleeding: Reported continuing bleeding from the described wound.
concepts.routine_prescription_refill: Patient explicitly requests a routine refill.
concepts.ran_out_regular_bp_medicine: Explicit report of having run out of usual blood-pressure medicine.
concepts.hypertension_history: Hypertension explicitly reported as known history; no inferred measurement.
concepts.pain_or_discomfort: Any pain or discomfort explicitly reported or denied.
concepts.dressing_recheck: A request for dressing recheck; not a conclusion that simple care is sufficient.
concepts.new_wound_pain: Reported new pain at the wound.
concepts.worsening: Explicit report of worsening or no worsening.
concepts.fainting: Reported fainting associated with the current complaint.
concepts.severe_distress: Explicitly reported severe distress; not a model judgment of clinical severity.
concepts.additional_symptoms: Symptoms beyond the stated complaint; absent requires an explicit scoped denial.
concepts.unmapped_symptom: An explicitly reported symptom cannot be represented by this vocabulary. Retain its evidence.
concepts.unresponsive_now: Proxy explicitly says the person currently cannot be woken, does not answer, or does not respond. Not ordinary sleep or fatigue.
concepts.gasping_or_noisy_breathing: Explicit current gasping, gurgling, or abnormal noisy breathing. Ordinary snoring without a current complaint is insufficient.
concepts.material_in_mouth: Explicit vomit, blood or pooled saliva currently in the mouth of the described person.
concepts.blue_colour: Proxy reports blue lips, face or area around the mouth; not a measured oxygen value.
concepts.active_convulsions: Ongoing whole-body shaking described as a current seizure-like event, or repeated episodes without waking between them. Not a diagnosis.
concepts.recent_seizure: Explicit report of a recent seizure event; a remote seizure history is insufficient.
concepts.pallor: Patient/proxy reports becoming pale with this event; not an examined finding.
concepts.dizziness: Reported dizziness, lightheadedness or a spinning sensation.
concepts.back_pain: Reported back pain; not automatically flank pain.
concepts.tearing_pain: Pain explicitly described as tearing or ripping.
concepts.new_motor_weakness: Explicit newly developed loss of strength in a limb or limbs; not general fatigue.
concepts.saddle_numbness: Reported reduced sensation between the legs or around the groin.
concepts.difficulty_urinating: Reported difficulty passing urine or urinary retention; not burning alone.
concepts.allergen_exposure: Reported exposure associated with a current allergic-type complaint; not inferred from the symptom alone.
concepts.lip_or_tongue_swelling: Reported swelling of the lips or tongue.
concepts.vision_change: Reported newly blurred, lost, or altered vision, including halos.
concepts.bloody_stool: Reported blood in stool or black tar-like stool.
concepts.general_weakness: Reported fatigue or generalized weakness, distinct from focal motor weakness.
concepts.repeated_vomiting: Explicit repeated vomiting or inability to keep intake down; one nausea episode is insufficient.
concepts.poor_oral_intake: Reported inability or marked difficulty keeping food or fluids down.
concepts.orthostatic_lightheadedness: Reported lightheadedness specifically on standing; not measured orthostatic hypotension.
concepts.limb_injury: Reported recent injury to an arm, leg or joint; do not infer fracture.
concepts.limb_pain: Reported pain in an arm, leg or joint.
concepts.limb_swelling: Reported swelling of an injured limb or joint.
concepts.preserved_limb_function: Explicit retained ability to walk, move, or feel the injured limb; not a neurovascular examination.
concepts.skin_cut: Reported cut or laceration of the skin.
concepts.bleeding_stopped: Explicit report that the current wound bleeding has stopped or is controlled.
concepts.ear_foreign_body: Explicit account of an object remaining lodged in the ear; not a suspected diagnosis.
concepts.localized_itchy_skin: Explicit limited itchy skin patch or a few localized itchy bites; not a generalized eruption.
concepts.generalized_rash: Explicit widespread rash or hives; not a few localized spots.
concepts.feels_well: Explicit statement of otherwise feeling normal or well. Does not independently establish every symptom as absent.
concepts.no_acute_symptoms: Explicit scoped statement of no current symptoms; not a missing or unreported symptom field.
concepts.usual_activities_preserved: Explicitly able to carry out usual daily activities.
concepts.eating_drinking_normally: Explicitly able to eat or drink normally.
concepts.symptoms_improving: Explicit improvement of the current complaint; stable or unchanged is not improvement.
concepts.head_injury: Reported recent blow or injury to the head.
concepts.anticoagulant_use: Explicit reported use of an anticoagulant; do not infer from a condition.
concepts.chills: Reported chills or shivering with the current complaint.
concepts.numbness: Reported loss or reduction of sensation.
concepts.tenderness: Patient reports soreness or tenderness, not an examination finding.
